prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Embedded customer analytics
client: confidential
client_industry: B2B SaaS
start: 2023-06
end: 2023-08
engagement: hourly
stack:
- React
- TypeScript
- Recharts
- Node.js
- PostgreSQL
implied_skills:
- data visualization
built: Usage dashboards embedded in a SaaS product so each customer account sees its
  own metrics.
metrics:
- rolled out to 140 customer accounts
- delivered 3 weeks early

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: how the client's team works now.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "a client in B2B SaaS (name withheld)".
- Never use these words or phrases: "data visualization". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
